parole.significato: Used to form adjectives from verbs, to express that "something can be done with the person or thing described".
parole.testo: Adjective: From Middle High German -lich, -līch, from Old High German -līh, from Proto-West Germanic *-līk. Cognate with English -ly and Dutch -lijk. Adverb: From Middle High German -līche, from Old High German -līhho.
